description: Manage Bundles via `action` (list | create | update | delete) — named topical filters backed by Calibre saved searches (e.g. a 'rust' bundle scoping searches to Rust books). A name starting with '-' is an exclusion marker. Also lists virtual libraries, which are read-only here. Preview-first: create/update/delete preview until confirm=true. Previews work without writes; applying needs CALIBRE_MCP_ENABLE_WRITE.
name: calibre_manage_bundles

writeEnabled.description: false on a preview in a session with writes disabled: applying it will be refused (write_disabled)

title: Manage bundles (saved searches)
